Definition: Gedor, a place in Palestine; also the name of three Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Gedor = "wall"; n pr m; 1) a son of Penuel; 2) a son of Jered; 3) a Benjamite of Gibeon; n pr loc; 4) a town in the mountainous part of Judah a few miles north of Hebron
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
